tests/fixtures/silero_vad.onnx
==============================

Silero VAD v6.2.3 ONNX model, byte-identical to
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/snakers4/silero-vad/master/src/silero_vad/data/silero_vad.onnx
and to the copy in the silero-vad 6.2.3 wheel.
sha256 1a153a22f4509e292a94e67d6f9b85e8deb25b4988682b7e174c65279d8788e3, 2327524 bytes.
Committed for the CI tests (ARCHITECTURE.md section 10). It is redistributed under its
own licence, reproduced below.
